title: The Importance of “Horcruxes” as a Support System for Professional and Personal Growth
content: During the last holiday season, I (Octavio) found myself watching a marathon of Harry Potter movies between Christmas and New Year's. If you are a Potterhead, you may have noticed a recurring pattern: in each film, the Warner Bros. logo gradually darkens as the series progresses. Arguably, it is a subtle way to indicate the magnitude of the threat that the Dark Lord Voldemort represents to the wizarding world. Throughout the movies, we see Harry occasionally asking for help. Due to his loveless upbringing and his distrust of authority, Harry often tries to handle confrontations with the Dark Lord on his own. Nevertheless, when faced with truly dangerous situations, he relies heavily on his closest friends for support.
